title: Minecraft celebrates 15th anniversary with limited-time in-game event
content: Microsoft and Mojang are celebrating Minecraft's 15th anniversary with a month-long in-game event featuring limited-edition cosmetics, a commemorative map pack, and a community-voted mob addition. The anniversary sale offers 30% off the base game across all platforms through April 15. A short documentary about Minecraft's development history will premiere on YouTube. 'Fifteen years of creativity, community, and endless adventures — we are endlessly grateful to our players,' said Mojang Studios CEO Ulrika Søndergaard. The game currently has over 140 million monthly active players.
